hero.label: TCS Academy
hero.headline: Training & continuing education
hero.intro: Continuing education for planning, installation and service – practical, flexible and certified.

formate.headline: Training formats
formate.intro: Whether digital or on-site – choose the format that suits you.

produktschulungen.title: Product training
produktschulungen.desc: Practical training on all TCS systems – from door communication and access control to the BCM system. Learn installation, configuration and commissioning directly on the device.

webinare.title: Webinars
webinare.desc: Digital learning formats on demand – flexible and location-independent. Current topics on planning, technology and new products in a compact format.

zertifizierung.title: Certification
zertifizierung.desc: Proof of competence for specialist partners. With the TCS certification you document your know-how and qualify for exclusive partner programs.

vorOrt.title: On-site training
vorOrt.desc: Individual training directly with your team. We come to you and train your staff hands-on on your specific projects.

zielgruppen.headline: Who is the TCS Academy for?
zielgruppen.intro: Our training courses are aimed at everyone who plans, installs or manages TCS products.

elektro.title: Electricians & specialist tradespeople
elektro.desc: Installation, wiring and commissioning of TCS systems

fachplaner.title: Specialist planners & architects
fachplaner.desc: System planning, configuration and tender preparation

facility.title: Facility managers & property administrators
facility.desc: BCM software, access management and building management

fachhandel.title: Specialist trade & sales partners
fachhandel.desc: Product knowledge, consulting expertise and partner programs

partner.headline: Partner programs
partner.intro: Value-added programs for specialist companies – benefit from exclusive advantages as a certified TCS partner.

silber.title: Silver partner
silber.desc: Entry level with basic training and access to the partner shop.

gold.title: Gold partner
gold.desc: Advanced training, priority support and marketing assistance.

platin.title: Platinum partner
platin.desc: Highest level with a personal contact and project support.

cta.headline: Request training now
cta.text: Contact us for individual training dates or sign up for the next webinar.
